# AccuSpan Gases (AG Gases & Equipment Ltd)

> AccuSpan Gases have built a worldwide business around supplying Specialty gases. UK manufacturer of calibration gases and specialty gases in non-refillable (NRC) and high-pressure refillable (HPC) cylinders, based in Stoke-on-Trent. Part of the Spantech Group.

Contact: info@accuspangases.com · +44 (0) 1782 616611 · Unit 1a, Britannic Works, Broom Street, Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, ST1 2ER, United Kingdom

## Group

- AG Gases & Equipment Ltd (AccuSpan Gases): parent company, Stoke-on-Trent, United Kingdom
- AccuSpan Gases UK: manufacturing and distribution for the UK and Europe
- AccuSpan Calgas India Pvt Ltd (AccuSpan Gases India): joint venture with Noble Enterprises; India, Middle East, South-East Asia
- AccuSpan Gases EU Distribution Hub: Spijkenisse, near Rotterdam, Netherlands
